keep_playing_why: B paid me more for what I did: the BLOOM crowd-clear with x4 score, 'Olive Terraces restored' with the colour flooding back, and a perk after each village. Game A had its good moments (a drift at night, a +1,000 lamp post) but a third of my time was spent in the off-road magnet rescue or pinned on a guardrail. B frustrated me more with sudden deaths, but when it worked I wanted the next village.
better_made_why: A is a clean portrait one-thumb game with an obvious first action (hold to drive), a good HUD, steady music and a lot of weather and time-of-day variety, and it never put me in a wall or a black screen. It did glitch (car stuck on guardrails, a rollover, road markings painted onto fields). B has richer art and better juice when it works, but its camera repeatedly clipped into houses and stalls, the screen went black a few times, aim drifted up and down, and I died fast to enemies I could not see.
furthest_A: Yozakura Pass, Easy: 38 mi, best score 11,249 at about 540 s (in-game clock 23:42, night with rain, through a tunnel and the golden hour, blue hour and night phases). Dawn never came.
furthest_B: Valley of Vell, Rush run: restored The Olive Terraces (86 s) and Millbrook (190 s), 2 of 5 inkwells, 9.4% restored, best score about 189,950. At 542 s I was at Windmill Ridge with 1 node broken (Vell Market half done, then lost to a death). Died 7 times.
